name: figures
js: (() => { const C = window.CITY, G = C.GEO, out = { arrays: {}, props: {}, frameKeys: Object.keys(G.frame || {}) }; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(G)) if (Array.isArray(v)) out.arrays[k] = v.length; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(G.props || {})) out.props[k] = Array.isArray(v) ? v.length : typeof v; const names = new Set(); for (const r of G.roads) if (r[0]) names.add(String(r[0])); out.namedRoadNames = names.size; out.roadRows = G.roads.length; out.frame = G.frame && (G.frame.detail || null); out.mobile = !!(window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches); out.treesPlaced = (G.trees && G.trees.length) || null; out.quality = window.__CITY_APP.quality && window.__CITY_APP.quality.tier; out.href = location.href; return out; })()
